description: Software permitted in the DSD pipeline. Every tool is pinned by revision or effective terms version. Generated text remains draft until a human approves its exact hash; no tool can approve or publish content directly.

tools.blockedReason: Superseded on 2026-08-11 by the approved local MLX architecture. Retained for historical provenance only; it is not an authorized fallback.
tools.notes: Historical direct api.openai.com Responses/Batch scaffold with strict Structured Outputs. OpenRouter and compatible proxy URLs are rejected in code. Superseded and blocked; it cannot enter new DSD production runs.

Official Qwen3-14B weights, locally converted to MLX 4-bit. Approved roles after calibration are independent candidate inventory and English learner-content authoring only. Thinking is disabled and no hidden reasoning is stored.

Official Qwen3-8B weights, locally converted to MLX 4-bit. Context-isolated critic: receives final DSD candidate or English fields and stable rubrics only; never generator reasoning, legacy content, or similarity wording.

Official gated TranslateGemma 12B IT weights, locally converted to MLX 4-bit. English-to-Vietnamese field translation only; never inventory or English-source authoring. Gemma Terms are a deliberate custom-license exception.

aliases: DSD local three-model text pipeline v1
tools.notes: Provider-neutral curation provenance envelope for the locked Qwen3-14B author, isolated Qwen3-8B critic, and TranslateGemma-12B translator. Per-request evidence remains bound to each underlying model, prompt, schema and input hash.

Used to generate new learner definitions, Vietnamese renderings and bilingual examples from blank DSD prompts. The exact underlying runtime model identifier is not exposed to this session, so every batch records the visible product, generation date, prompt-policy ID and output hashes. No legacy text is supplied as input.
Apache-2.0. American English with fallback=None. Produces IPA candidates only; a human authors the final pronunciation record.
MIT. General English IPA. Old native dependencies require a feasibility check before adoption.

Internal build tool on DSD-controlled machines only. Not bundled into any customer-distributed client. eSpeak NG in the phonemization path is GPL; program output is not covered, but binary distribution is a separate question kept out of scope.
